source: Keep in mind that all options extended from {0} will be overwritten by the options defined in your {1}. Overwriting options such as {2} with your own configuration will lead TypeScript to not factor in the module resolutions from {3}. This can lead to module resolutions such as {4} not being recognized.{5}{6}In case you need to extend options provided by {7} further, you can use the {8}{9} property{/8} within your {10}. Nuxt will pick them up and extend {11} accordingly.
